desc: Encode JSON into MessagePack binary (hex), or decode MessagePack hex back into JSON.
meta.description: Encode JSON into MessagePack binary (hex), or decode MessagePack hex back into JSON.
meta.title: MessagePack Codec - S-Jiffy
ui.106: Decoding supports fixint / int8-64 / uint8-64 / float32-64 / str (fixstr, str8/16/32) / array (fixarray, array16/32) / map (fixmap, map16/32); int64 / uint64 are shown as strings to avoid precision loss; bin / ext types are not supported yet.
ui.107: Supports nil / boolean / integers (fixint, int8/16/32/64, uint8/16/32/64) / floats (float64) / strings (UTF-8) / arrays / maps; pure digit strings longer than 16 digits are encoded as int64.
ui.11: Please check that brackets, quotes, and commas are complete.
ui.15: Contains invalid characters: only hex digits (0-9, a-f, A-F) and spaces are allowed
ui.16: Map length is out of range (over 2GB)
ui.17: Array length is out of range (over 2GB)
ui.20: String length is out of range (over 2GB)
ui.21: Unsupported type: ext (extension type), please use str instead
ui.22: Unsupported type: bin (binary), please use str instead
ui.23: Incomplete data, unable to read float
ui.24: Incomplete data, unable to read integer
ui.25: (supports null / boolean / number / string / array / object)
ui.7: bytes left unconsumed (data may contain extra bytes).
